conceptZh: 科學家老鼠的燒杯一聲砰，雨雲彈出來，最後田在雨下面。
morph: a bubbling beaker pops a cloud and four drops, with 田 beneath
creativeAngle: 燒杯冒泡，一個接一個彈出來。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a pale-lilac lab with cream shelves; the glyph is solid cobalt-blue 雷: 雨 above 田. A bespectacled lab mouse stands among bubbling beakers. The Traditional Chinese glyph 雷 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the mouse pours a blue liquid into a flask; foam rises; the first 雷 is spoken as it fizzes. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the flask pops a fluffy cloud, four drops arrange into 雨 and a square 田 drops beneath; the second 雷 is spoken as the square lands. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): the cloud flashes a gentle yellow zig-zag with a deep rumble; 打雷 is spoken as the mouse hops back and his glasses fog. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 雷 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the mouse wipes his glasses and gives thumbs up. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「雷、雷、打雷」, read as ㄌㄟˊ、ㄌㄟˊ、ㄉㄚˇ ㄌㄟˊ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.5s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only fizz and soft rumble, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
